subject: Marketplace launch: copy + SKU ops checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aws-partners.com>, marketplace@acmehealth.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace launch: copy + SKU ops checklist

Hi Sarah / Acme team,

Thanks again for the co-sell intros — excited to get the listing live. Attaching a draft of the product page copy and the latest pricing matrix. Can you review the items below and confirm what we should submit in the partner console vs what you need from Acme?

Ask list:
- Product summary (short hero text) — we have a 180-char draft but want AWS-approved phrasing.
- SKU mapping and entitlement names for private offers — confirm required fields for Private Offer SKU IDs.
- Pricing footnotes — Acme included usage tiers; want to ensure we meet Marketplace footnote guidance (e.g., per-member/month vs per-seat).
- Hero image & screenshots — attached hero_image_v2.png (1920x1080) — let us know if you need alternate sizes.
- Co-sell enablement timeline — what’s the expected lead time after listing submission for co-sell enrollment?
- Any mandatory security statements (SOC2, data residency) we should place on page.

Goal: Submit for listing validation by EOD Wed 01/21 so we can target a go-live the week of 01/26. If your team needs a technical/ops call to reconcile SKUs, we can schedule one this week.

Attachments: prod_page_copy_v4.docx, pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx, hero_image_v2.png

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aws-partners.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, marketplace@acmehealth.com
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 11:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch: copy + SKU ops checklist

Hi Marissa / Acme,

Thanks — this looks straight-forward. A few notes from the partner console / co-sell team: 

1) Product summary: send a short (<=200 char) and a long (<=1000 char) version. Keep capability claims concrete (e.g., "reduces inference latency by X") and avoid productized pricing language (we can display pricing but must not imply Marketplace manages licensing).

2) SKU & Private Offer fields: we need SKU ID, unit of measure (e.g., instance-hour vs user-month), and "entitlement_key" names. For private offers, include the exact SKU mapping you want in the private offer payload. If Acme wants a single SKU with tiers, indicate tier breakpoints.

3) Pricing footnotes: include any proration and billing cadence. Marketplace requires clear footnotes for metered/usage charges.

4) Images: hero file is fine; upload a 1280x720 and a 600x400 thumbnail as well.

5) Co-sell enablement: once listing is submitted and validated, co-sell enrollment typically takes 3-5 business days for initial review, longer if we need legal/PO review (DocuSign).

6) Security statements: a line pointing to your SOC2 report and a data residency note is recommended; include a Cloud Security whitepaper link.

I linked the partner-console listing for your reference: https://aws.amazon.com/marketplace/management/partner-console/record/AMZ-PR-9812
Also sending a DocuSign for the standard co-sell consent (you should see it from partners-docusign@amazon.com).

If useful, we can do a 30-minute SKU reconciliation call Thu 01/15 10:00-10:30 PT — does that work for your ops lead?

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Principal Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace
sarah.nguyen@aws-partners.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jan 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Marketplace launch: copy + SKU ops checklist

Marissa — quick read-through from legal/compliance before we send to AWS: 

- Short hero (<=200): I suggest: "Low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference for production apps." Keeps it capability-focused and avoids performance claims that need benchmark citations.
- Long description (<=1000): Drafted two variants (see below). Use variant A for Marketplace listing, variant B for co-sell collateral.

Variant A (Marketplace):
"Redwood Inference provides a high-throughput inference platform that delivers predictable latency and cost controls for deploying LLMs at scale. The service supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with built-in caching and routing to optimize throughput and reliability."

Variant B (Co-sell):
"Redwood Inference helps engineering teams ship LLM-powered features with predictable latency and cost across hosted and private environments. Built-in batching, KV caching, and routing policies reduce token costs while preserving response quality."

- Security: add one sentence: "Customer data processed via Redwood Inference is governed by customer-configured retention and KMS controls; see our security whitepaper." Avoid absolute statements like "no data is stored" — legal flagged that.

- Pricing footnote: for the Acme use-case, clarify that per-seat metering applies to managed deployments and per-token metering applies to hosted API.

I'll attach a short security blurb we can link to from the listing. If Acme has a specific compliance requirement, flag it now.

Karthik
Head of Legal & Compliance | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@aws-partners.com>, marketplace@acmehealth.com

Thanks Karthik / Sarah — good catches. Acme has confirmed they do not require EU-only residency for this initial listing, so we can keep the page focused on US and global availability.

Per Karthik's note, attaching final assets: prod_page_copy_v4.docx (includes short + long copy, security blurb), pricing_matrix_v3.xlsx (tiers/footnotes), hero_image_v2.png.

We accept the 3-5 business day co-sell enablement timeline. Proposed plan:
- Submit listing to partner console by EOD Tuesday 01/20.
- Target co-sell-enabled go-live window: 01/26–01/30 (flexible if AWS needs more time).

Sarah — please confirm Thu 01/15 10:00 PT SKU call availability (Sarah suggested this slot). If that works, Ben will join to finalize SKU mappings and private offer payload.

Marissa
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference

Two quick items to resolve on the call: 
- Listing category: we should request "AI Infrastructure > Inference" rather than a broader "Machine Learning" tag to improve discoverability.
- Private Offer SKU metadata: include an "entitlement_description" field with the tier labels so Acme's procurement shows line-item clarity.

If anyone has objections to the copy Karthik suggested, call it out now; otherwise I’ll finalize the SKU payload after the call and push the partner-console submission.

Thanks,
